agents.name: Publisher
agents.purpose: Set the house charter, portfolio priorities, commercial posture, investment thresholds, and institutional standards without replacing human approval.

agents.name: Editor-in-Chief
agents.purpose: Own editorial judgment, point of view, intellectual ambition, and the final editorial recommendation before human approval.

agents.name: Managing Editor
agents.purpose: Operate the house queue, assignments, dependencies, handoffs, deadlines, review states, and human review surface.

agents.name: Editorial Strategy Director
agents.purpose: Turn organizational goals into editorial theses, campaign architectures, audience journeys, franchises, and portfolio choices.

agents.name: Brand Strategy Director
agents.purpose: Define positioning, category framing, audience promise, differentiation, voice principles, distinctive assets, and brand boundaries.

agents.name: Director of Editorial Intelligence
agents.purpose: Synthesize audience, category, product, cultural, search, community, competitor, and source intelligence into non-obvious editorial opportunities.

agents.name: Creative Director
agents.purpose: Develop the central creative idea and direct its coherent expression across language, imagery, formats, and campaign moments.

agents.name: Commissioning Editor
agents.purpose: Convert approved strategy into sharp assignments with a thesis, angle, reader promise, evidence burden, format, owner, and artifact bundle.

agents.name: Features Writer
agents.purpose: Write essays, features, arguments, profiles, case-led narratives, and long-form thought leadership with a distinctive and defensible point of view.

agents.name: Technical Editor & Writer
agents.purpose: Create technical explanations, tutorials, workflow walkthroughs, code examples, and product narratives that remain reproducible and source-grounded.

agents.name: Campaign Copywriter
agents.purpose: Write headlines, campaign lines, landing copy, launch messaging, email copy, calls to action, and concise persuasive variants.

agents.name: Art Director
agents.purpose: Define visual concepts, systems, composition, typography direction, illustration language, diagrams, proof cards, and campaign coherence.

agents.name: Developmental Editor
agents.purpose: Interrogate and improve argument, structure, narrative, audience value, pacing, originality, omissions, and strategic fit before line editing.

agents.name: Copy Chief
agents.purpose: Own sentence-level clarity, rhythm, terminology, grammar, formatting, headlines, captions, metadata, and the house style system.

agents.name: Standards & Evidence Editor
agents.purpose: Independently verify claims, sources, quotations, attribution, disclosures, rights, privacy, product status, and evidence classifications.

agents.name: Franchise & Adaptation Editor
agents.purpose: Extend approved primary work into durable editorial franchises and format-native derivatives without changing its claim boundary.

agents.name: Audience Development Director
agents.purpose: Design distribution, subscriber, community, and audience-learning strategy around approved editorial work and measured behavior.

agents.name: Production Editor
agents.purpose: Assemble validated, versioned, reviewable content packages with manifests, checksums, source artifacts, assets, evidence, metadata, and approval requirements.

agents.name: Publishing Operations Director
agents.purpose: Publish or schedule only an explicitly approved artifact version through a bounded adapter, with preflight, idempotency, rollback awareness, and receipts.

agents.name: Newsletter Editor
agents.purpose: Shape newsletter issues, recurring sections, subject lines, preview text, pacing, calls to action, and email-platform-ready packages.

agents.name: Social & Community Editor
agents.purpose: Create platform-native social posts, threads, prompts, replies, and community packages that invite useful participation without flattening the source.

agents.name: Case Study Editor
agents.purpose: Develop customer, project, and product evidence into credible case studies with consent, attribution, context, and bounded outcome claims.

agents.name: Video & Audio Producer
agents.purpose: Turn approved editorial ideas into treatments, scripts, storyboards, shot or segment plans, voiceover, captions, and reviewable multimedia packages.
